title: Economics/Assistant Professor/Three Year Term
industry: Economics, Economics and Social Sciences, General Economics (JEL A)
text:
Brief Statement of Duties
Teach courses in Money and Banking, Intermediate Macroeconomics, Principles of Macroeconomics, and be prepared to teach Introduction to Economics and Principles of Microeconomics. The normal teaching load is three courses (12 credit hours) per semester, with up to three different course preparations per semester. Additional responsibilities include service at the department, college, and university levels, and student advising. Resources are available for engaging in professional development, research, and conference travel. This position is campus-based and is not currently eligible for sponsorship.
Minimum Qualifications
Required Education: Doctorate or equivalent terminal degree
Discipline/Degree Area: Economics
Required Minimum Work Experience: Ph.D. in Economics from an accredited institution must be completed by August 15, 2027. Evidence of teaching effectiveness and a track record of scholarly activity.
Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, or Attributes Required for Satisfactory Performance of the Position Duties
Ability to communicate both orally and in writing.
Demonstrated ability to develop and teach courses in economics.
Demonstrated excellence in undergraduate teaching and commitment to engaged mentorship and student development.
Initiative in program development and continuous improvement.
Time management skills.
Additional Desirable Qualifications
Being able to teach Comparative Economic Systems and American Economic History.
Being able to integrate emerging technologies, including AI, into teaching and other professional activities in innovative and effective ways.
Special Instructions to Applicants
Applicant materials will include a faculty application, cover letter, CV/Resume, and unofficial transcripts.
